verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ הוֹשֵׁ֙עַ֙ בֶּן־ בְּאֵרִ֔י בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֥ה יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֛י יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- hō·wō·šê·a‘ ben- bə·’ê·rî bî·mê ‘uz·zî·yāh yō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḥāz yə·ḥiz·qî·yāh mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·mê yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- yō·w·’āš me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: [This is] the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah Jotham Ahaz and Hezekiah kings of Judah and [of] Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבֶּר־ בְּהוֹשֵׁ֑עַ פ יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לֵ֣ךְ קַח־ זְנוּנִים֙ לְךָ֞ אֵ֤שֶׁת וְיַלְדֵ֣י זְנוּנִ֔ים כִּֽי־ הָאָ֔רֶץ זָנֹ֤ה תִזְנֶה֙ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh tə·ḥil·laṯ dib·ber- bə·hō·šē·aʿ p̄ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- hō·wō·šê·a‘ lêḵ qaḥ- zə·nū·nîm lə·ḵā ’ê·šeṯ wə·yal·ḏê zə·nū·nîm kî- hā·’ā·reṣ zā·nōh ṯiz·neh mê·’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea He told . . . him Go take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself . . . [by departing] from the LORD

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּקַּ֔ח אֶת־ גֹּ֖מֶר בַּת־ דִּבְלָ֑יִם וַתַּ֥הַר וַתֵּֽלֶד־ ל֖וֹ בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- gō·mer baṯ- diḇ·lā·yim wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ- lōw bên
verses.literal: So [Hosea] went and married - Gomer daughter of Diblaim and she conceived and bore him a son

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל כִּי־ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֗ט וּפָ֨קַדְתִּ֜י אֶת־ דְּמֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יֵה֔וּא וְהִ֨שְׁבַּתִּ֔י מַמְלְכ֖וּת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw qə·rā šə·mōw yiz·rə·‘el kî- ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ’eṯ- də·mê yiz·rə·‘el ‘al- bêṯ yê·hū wə·hiš·bat·tî mam·lə·ḵūṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to [Hosea] Name him . . . Jezreel for soon . . . I will bring - the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu and I will put an end to the kingdom vvv of Israel

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ קֶ֣שֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·šā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- qe·šeṯ yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ê·meq yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: And on that day I will break - the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel

verses.original: עוֹד֙ וַתַּ֤הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בַּ֔ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ קְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אוֹסִ֜יף ע֗וֹד אֲרַחֵם֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ נָשֹׂ֥א אֶשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ baṯ way·yō·mer lōw qə·rā šə·māh lō ru·ḥā·māh kî lō ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ ’ă·ra·ḥêm ’eṯ- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî- nā·śō ’eś·śā lā·hem
verses.literal: [Gomer] again conceived and gave birth to a daughter and [the LORD] said to [Hosea] Name her vvv Lo-ruhamah for I will no longer . . . have compassion - on the house of Israel that I should ever forgive . . . them

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֲרַחֵ֔ם בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ וְהֽוֹשַׁעְתִּ֖ים וְלֹ֣א אֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֗ם בְּקֶ֤שֶׁת וּבְחֶ֙רֶב֙ וּבְמִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסוּסִ֖ים וּבְפָרָשִֽׁים׃ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ra·ḥêm bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tîm wə·lō ’ō·wō·šî·‘êm bə·qe·šeṯ ū·ḇə·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇə·mil·ḥā·māh bə·sū·sîm ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah and I will save them not - by bow or sword or war not by horses and cavalry but by the LORD their God

verses.original: וַתִּגְמֹ֖ל אֶת־ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·mōl ’eṯ- lō ru·ḥā·māh wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ bên
verses.literal: After she had weaned - vvv Lo-ruhamah [Gomer] conceived and gave birth to a son

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֑י כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹֽא־ אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qə·rā šə·mōw lō ‘am·mî kî ’at·tem lō ‘am·mî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō- ’eh·yeh lå̄·ḵɛm
verses.literal: And [the LORD] said Name him vvv Lo-ammi for you are not My people and I am not your God . . .

verses.original: מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְֽ֠הָיָה כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָהֶם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם לֹֽא־ עַמִּ֣י יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י חָֽי׃ אֵֽל־
verses.transliteration: mis·par bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·yāh kə·ḥō·wl hay·yām ’ă·šer lō- yim·maḏ wə·lō yis·sā·p̄êr wə·hā·yāh bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yê·’ā·mêr lā·hem ’at·tem lō- ‘am·mî yê·’ā·mêr lā·hem bə·nê ḥāy ’êl-
verses.literal: Yet the number vvv of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea which cannot be measured [or] counted And it will happen that in the [very] place where it was said to them You [are] not My people they will be called . . . sons of the living God

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֤ה וּבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ֠נִקְבְּצוּ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם אֶחָ֖ד רֹ֥אשׁ וְעָל֣וּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·niq·bə·ṣū yaḥ·dāw wə·śā·mū lā·hem ’e·ḥāḏ rōš wə·‘ā·lū min- hā·’ā·reṣ kî ḡā·ḏō·wl yō·wm yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: Then the people of Judah [and] of Israel will be gathered together and they will appoint for themselves one leader and will go up out of the land For great [will be] the day of Jezreel
